_doc: Pests and diseases for the pilot crops (maize, paddy, wheat, tomato, potato), prioritised from Kisan Call Centre UP 2024 query frequencies. Adding a crop = adding its id to `hosts` of shared causes and adding its own causes here; no retraining. Example `actives` are commonly recommended in Indian extension advice; they are filtered against kb/rules.json and must be used only at the label dose registered for the crop. Edges with ev 'Contra' document known-harmful advice that the engine must prune (kept so the pruning is testable).

causes.desc: fall armyworm: ragged holes and windows in young maize leaves, wet sawdust-like frass in the whorl, caterpillar with an inverted Y on its head

criteria.en: Is there wet sawdust-like dirt (frass) inside the central whorl?
criteria.hi: क्या गोभ के अंदर गीला बुरादे जैसा मल है?

criteria.en: Does the caterpillar have a pale inverted 'Y' mark on its head?
criteria.hi: क्या सुंडी के सिर पर उल्टा 'Y' निशान है?

causes.desc: maize stem borer: shot holes in a row across leaves, dead heart (central shoot dries and pulls out easily), tunnels in the stem

criteria.en: Does the dried central shoot pull out easily?
criteria.hi: क्या सूखा बीच का पत्ता खींचने पर आसानी से निकल आता है?

criteria.en: Are there small holes in a straight row across the leaves?
criteria.hi: क्या पत्तियों पर एक कतार में छोटे छेद हैं?

causes.desc: northern leaf blight: long cigar-shaped grey-green to tan lesions on maize leaves starting from the lower leaves, in cool humid weather

criteria.en: Are the spots long and cigar-shaped (several cm), grey to tan?
criteria.hi: क्या धब्बे लंबे, सिगार जैसे (कई सेमी), भूरे-धूसर हैं?

causes.desc: maydis leaf blight: small rectangular tan spots between the veins of maize leaves, joining up in warm humid weather

criteria.en: Are the spots small, rectangular and limited by the veins?
criteria.hi: क्या धब्बे छोटे, आयताकार और नसों के बीच सीमित हैं?

causes.desc: rice stem borer: dead hearts in tillers during vegetative stage or white empty earheads (white ear) after flowering that pull out easily

criteria.en: Are there white, empty earheads that pull out easily?
criteria.hi: क्या सफेद, खाली बालियाँ हैं जो आसानी से खिंच जाती हैं?

criteria.en: Are there buff-coloured egg masses near leaf tips?
criteria.hi: क्या पत्तियों की नोक पर हल्के भूरे अंडों के गुच्छे हैं?

causes.desc: rice leaf folder: leaves folded lengthwise and tied, with white scraped streaks inside, green caterpillar inside the fold

criteria.en: Are leaves folded lengthwise with white streaks where the green is scraped off?
criteria.hi: क्या पत्तियाँ लंबाई में मुड़ी हैं और अंदर हरा भाग खुरचा हुआ सफेद है?

causes.desc: brown planthopper: circular patches of paddy drying and collapsing (hopper burn), many small brown insects at the base of the plants

criteria.en: When you part the plants, are there many small brown insects at the base near the water?
criteria.hi: पौधों को हटाकर देखें, क्या नीचे पानी के पास बहुत छोटे भूरे कीट हैं?

criteria.en: Are there round patches where plants dry and fall over?
criteria.hi: क्या गोल घेरे में पौधे सूखकर गिर रहे हैं?

causes.desc: gundhi bug: slender green-brown bugs with a bad smell sucking milky grains, chaffy or spotted empty grains at milk stage

criteria.en: Is there a strong bad smell in the field and long thin bugs on the earheads?
criteria.hi: क्या खेत में तेज़ बदबू और बालियों पर लंबे पतले कीड़े हैं?

causes.desc: rice blast: diamond or eye-shaped spots with grey centre and brown border on leaves, neck of the panicle turns black and breaks

criteria.en: Are the spots spindle or eye-shaped with a grey centre and brown edge?
criteria.hi: क्या धब्बे आँख/नाव के आकार के, बीच में धूसर और किनारे भूरे हैं?

criteria.en: Is the neck of the earhead black and breaking?
criteria.hi: क्या बाली की गर्दन काली होकर टूट रही है?

causes.desc: bacterial leaf blight of rice: leaves drying from the tip downwards with a wavy yellow margin, milky ooze drops in the morning

criteria.en: Do leaves dry from the tip with a wavy yellow edge?
criteria.hi: क्या पत्तियाँ नोक से लहरदार पीले किनारे के साथ सूख रही हैं?

advice.why: agricultural use of streptomycin/tetracycline banned from 2024

causes.desc: sheath blight: oval grey-green lesions with brown borders on the leaf sheath near the water line, spreading upward like a snake skin

criteria.en: Are the lesions on the sheath near the water level, oval with a brown border?
criteria.hi: क्या धब्बे पानी के स्तर के पास तने के आवरण पर, अंडाकार भूरे किनारे वाले हैं?

causes.desc: false smut: individual rice grains replaced by yellow-orange to greenish-black velvety balls on the earhead

criteria.en: Are some grains turned into yellow or dark green velvety balls?
criteria.hi: क्या कुछ दाने पीले या गहरे हरे मखमली गोलों में बदल गए हैं?

advice.note: only protective at booting stage, not after balls appear

causes.desc: wheat yellow rust: bright yellow powdery pustules in stripes along the leaf, powder sticks to fingers, in cool humid weather January-February

criteria.en: Does yellow powder come off on your fingers when you rub the leaf?
criteria.hi: क्या पत्ती रगड़ने पर उँगलियों पर पीला पाउडर लगता है?

criteria.en: Are the yellow pustules arranged in stripes along the leaf?
criteria.hi: क्या पीले दाने पत्ती पर धारियों में हैं?

causes.desc: wheat brown rust: scattered round orange-brown powdery pustules on leaves, not in stripes, in warmer weather February-March

criteria.en: Are the pustules orange-brown and scattered (not in stripes)?
criteria.hi: क्या दाने नारंगी-भूरे और बिखरे हुए (धारियों में नहीं) हैं?

causes.desc: loose smut of wheat: earheads come out as black powdery masses instead of grains, the powder blows away leaving a bare stalk

criteria.en: Are whole earheads black powder instead of grain?
criteria.hi: क्या पूरी बाली दानों की जगह काला पाउडर है?

advice.note: as seed treatment for next season

causes.desc: aphids: colonies of tiny soft green or black insects on tender shoots, ears or under leaves, sticky honeydew and black sooty mould

criteria.en: Are there clusters of tiny soft insects on shoots or ears?
criteria.hi: क्या कोमल टहनियों या बालियों पर छोटे कोमल कीटों के झुंड हैं?

advice.note: only above threshold; conserve ladybird beetles

causes.desc: whitefly: tiny white flies fly up when the plant is shaken, leaves yellow and sticky; spreads leaf curl virus

criteria.en: Do tiny white flies fly up when you shake the plant?
criteria.hi: क्या पौधा हिलाने पर छोटी सफेद मक्खियाँ उड़ती हैं?

causes.desc: termites: plants drying in patches, roots and stem base hollow and eaten, mud tunnels, worse in dry sandy soils and with raw manure

criteria.en: Do dried plants pull out easily with eaten roots and soil inside?
criteria.hi: क्या सूखे पौधे आसानी से उखड़ते हैं और जड़ें खाई हुई, अंदर मिट्टी भरी है?

advice.note: seed treatment at sowing is most effective

causes.desc: cutworm: young plants cut off at ground level overnight, fat grey-brown caterpillars curled in the soil nearby, holes in potato tubers

criteria.en: Are young plants cut cleanly at the soil level overnight?
criteria.hi: क्या छोटे पौधे रात में मिट्टी की सतह से कटे मिलते हैं?

causes.desc: early blight: dark brown spots with concentric target rings on older lower leaves first, yellow around the spots

criteria.en: Do the spots have rings inside like a target, on the older leaves first?
criteria.hi: क्या धब्बों में निशाने जैसे छल्ले हैं, पहले पुरानी पत्तियों पर?

causes.desc: late blight: large water-soaked dark patches spreading fast on leaves and stems in cool foggy humid weather, white mould under the leaf, whole field can collapse in days

criteria.en: Did dark wet-looking patches spread fast after cool, foggy or rainy days?
criteria.hi: क्या ठंडे, कोहरे या बारिश के बाद काले गीले धब्बे तेज़ी से फैले?

criteria.en: Is there white fuzzy growth under the leaf at the edge of the patch?
criteria.hi: क्या धब्बे के किनारे पत्ती के नीचे सफेद रुई जैसी फफूंद है?

causes.desc: bacterial spot: many small dark greasy water-soaked spots with yellow halo on tomato leaves and raised scabby spots on fruits, after rain

criteria.en: Are the spots small, dark and greasy-looking with a yellow ring?
criteria.hi: क्या धब्बे छोटे, काले, चिकने दिखने वाले पीले घेरे के साथ हैं?

advice.why: agricultural use of streptomycin/tetracycline banned from 2024

causes.desc: tomato leaf curl virus: young leaves small, curled upward and crinkled, yellow edges, bushy stunted plants with few flowers, whiteflies present

criteria.en: Are young leaves small, cupped upward and crinkled?
criteria.hi: क्या नई पत्तियाँ छोटी, ऊपर मुड़ी और सिकुड़ी हैं?

causes.desc: fruit borer: round holes in green fruits with the caterpillar half inside, rotting fruits, greenish caterpillars with stripes

criteria.en: Are there round holes in fruits with a caterpillar's body sticking out?
criteria.hi: क्या फलों में गोल छेद हैं और सुंडी का आधा शरीर बाहर दिखता है?

causes.desc: fusarium wilt: plants wilt and yellow on one side, lower leaves first, stem shows brown streaks inside when cut, does not recover at night

criteria.en: When you cut the stem near the base, is the inside streaked brown?
criteria.hi: तने को नीचे से काटने पर क्या अंदर भूरी धारियाँ हैं?

criteria.en: Do wilted plants stay wilted even in the morning?
criteria.hi: क्या मुरझाए पौधे सुबह भी मुरझाए रहते हैं?

causes.name_hi: फल के निचले सिरे की सड़न
causes.desc: blossom-end rot: dark sunken leathery patch at the bottom end of the fruit, caused by calcium not reaching the fruit with uneven watering

criteria.en: Is the dark sunken patch always at the bottom (flower) end of the fruit?
criteria.hi: क्या काला धँसा धब्बा हमेशा फल के निचले (फूल वाले) सिरे पर है?

causes.desc: flower and fruit drop: flowers fall without setting fruit, often from heat above 35 degrees, cold nights, water stress, excess nitrogen or poor pollination

criteria.en: Are flowers falling off before fruits form?
criteria.hi: क्या फल बनने से पहले फूल गिर रहे हैं?

causes.desc: black scurf: hard black dirt-like crusts on potato tubers that do not wash off, sometimes cankers on sprouts and poor emergence

criteria.en: Are there hard black crusts on tubers that don't wash off?
criteria.hi: क्या कंदों पर सख्त काली पपड़ी है जो धोने से नहीं जाती?

causes.desc: common scab: rough corky raised or pitted spots on potato tuber skin, worse in dry, alkaline soil at tuber formation

criteria.en: Are the spots rough, corky and on the skin only?
criteria.hi: क्या धब्बे खुरदुरे, कॉर्क जैसे और सिर्फ छिलके पर हैं?

causes.desc: small potato tubers: crop healthy but tubers small, from close spacing, late or early harvest, water stress at tuber bulking, or low potash

criteria.en: Are the plants themselves healthy, only the tubers small?
criteria.hi: क्या पौधे स्वस्थ हैं, सिर्फ कंद छोटे हैं?
